note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.44-test, public pressing, all XA: no CD-DA track. Arcade, Cortex (Graybox Reach), Quake, NitroXide and VoXide are their 2026-10-15 XA builds and each carries its own music; PSXcel and Celeste are the v0.43 bare EXEs. Launcher menu music is XA (Mulula VGM Loops, CC BY 4.0). Public pressing only: Half-Life, Hollow Knight, WipEout, Counter-Strike and the hardware tests are never on it. The `local` fields name checkouts on the build machine that hold each revision. Hashes gate every input; disc-tools lineup refuses a file that changed.

programs.name: PSXCEL
programs.build: make disc on a clean clone of main (SDK ee4a4b95, editor 4352b10a from its components.lock.json); the disc carries the image's boot EXE as a bare program

programs.name: PSOXIDE ARCADE
programs.build: make disc on feat/arcade-xa-music-2026-10-15 (SDK e6ec267, editor 9ad78b3, emulator 9e00783): Goncharov as MUSIC1.XA inside the image, one data track, no CD-DA. Receipt in campaign-2026-10-15/arcade-xa/RESULT.md.

programs.name: CELESTE COLLECTION
programs.build: make collection-disc on a clean clone of main (SDK 6628074a4, the ACK-paced controller fix); same source as the console-tested 0.2.6, rebuilt at a different checkout path (same EXE size, different layout bytes)

programs.name: NITROXIDE
programs.build: make compile and make pack with MUSIC_DIR on feat/nitroxide-xa-music-2026-10-15 (SDK EBonura/PSoXide integ/xa-pack-game-bytes-2026-10-15 5cec9331, committed PGO layout): six songs as MUSIC1.XA and MUSIC2.XA, one data track, no CD-DA.

programs.name: VOXIDE
programs.build: release/0.4.0-rc: the image is the release/voxide.bin committed in 591c43f (built from a698fc5, identical tree), four XA music pieces in the one data track, no CD-DA.

programs.name: QUAKE SHAREWARE
programs.build: cargo quake-build disc on feat/quake-xa-music-2026-10-15 (shareware 1.06 data, SDK 5e112a78): eight ambient loops, each stored three times end to end, in MUSIC1.XA and MUSIC2.XA inside the image, no CD-DA; no borrowing from the launcher. Disc label stays 0.1.1.

programs.name: CORTEX IGNITION
programs.build: frontend build-project-disc --project editor/projects/graybox-reach on feat/engine-xa-music-2026-10-15 (SDK 36ead4b, emulator 6edde550): the two Music nodes as MUSIC1.XA after UI.PAK, one data track, no CD-DA. The default (0.4b) project does not link on editor main, so Graybox Reach stands in the Cortex slot.
